مَقْلُودٌ : see قَلِيدٌ. ―
-b2- A bracelet formed of two bracelets of the kind called قُلْب twisted together: (L:) a twisted bracelet; as also ↓ قَلْدٌ : (L, K [the latter said in the K to be with fet-h, but in the L written قِلْدٌ:]) and the latter, [in the S written قَلْدٌ,] a bracelet made of twisted silver. (S, L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
